title: Years of Preferred Dividend Carried on an Estate Settlement Under Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
A preferred holding under Membership and Patronage Equity whose cash patronage has not reached the member carries the dividend for the years it has waited.

**Two years.** Where the class carries a dividend on preferred equity and no cash payment stands on the equity ledger for either the year most recently allocated or the year before it, the dividend is carried for 2 years.

**One year.** Where the class carries a dividend on preferred equity and a cash payment stands for the year before the year most recently allocated but none for the year most recently allocated, it is carried for 1 year.

**Otherwise.** No dividend arrears are carried.

## The readings on hypothetical records

| Class carries a dividend on preferred equity | Cash payment for the year most recently allocated | Cash payment for the year before it | Years carried |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| yes | none | none | 2 |
| yes | none | one stands | 1 |
| yes | one stands | none | none |
| yes | one stands | one stands | none |
| no | none | none | none |

**On the third and fourth lines.** Where a cash payment stands for the year most recently allocated, nothing is carried, whatever stands for the year before it.

**Worked.** Discounted equity of 13036.80 on a class whose own dividend rate on preferred equity is 4.5 in the hundred carries 1173.31 where 2 years are carried and 586.66 where 1 year is carried, the figure rounded to two decimal places. The class's own dividend rate is the rate applied, as the class schedule carries it.
